title: StreamFlow ergonomics: v1->v2 SDK migration guide, retries semantics, and changelog automation
creator: Marco Liu
description:
Purpose: produce a single, opinionated migration document that 1) explains behavioral changes from v1 -> v2 for streaming and retry semantics, 2) provides copy-paste examples for Python/TypeScript/Go showing recommended migration patterns, and 3) codifies an automated changelog generation pipeline that surfaces breaking warnings and deprecation notes for SDK consumers.

Background: multiple teams have received informal questions during the v2 beta about streaming stream ergonomics (cursor ownership, incremental error handling) and subtle retry behavior changes (idempotency keys, default backoff). There is no single authoritative guide combining examples, migration codemods, and the upstream changelog automation we want in the SDK repos. This ticket centralizes that work and produces docs and infra artifacts.
acceptance_criteria: A single migration guide page (docs.redwood.ai/sdk/migration/v1-to-v2/streamflow-and-retries) that covers behavioral deltas and sample code for Python/TS/Go
A runnable codemod (or CLI helper) that updates common v1 patterns to v2 ergonomics for streaming calls and retry configuration with a dry-run flag
Changelog automation wired via GH Action that parses @redwood/sdk commit markers and produces a draft CHANGELOG entry and deprecation summary in the release PR
Docs include a migration matrix table mapping old APIs/options to new equivalents and clear fallbacks for customers on Dedicated/Private deployments
Internal RFC summarizing trade-offs (backoff defaults, streaming error model) and signoff from SDK lead, PM, and a runtime engineer
tasks: Draft migration narrative and behavioral diff for streaming: explain 'streamflow' model (producer vs consumer checkpoints) and how v2 exposes per-chunk metadata
Document retry changes: explicit idempotency_key parameter, default exponential backoff (base=200ms, factor=2, jitter=0.1), and when to switch to 'no-retry' (streaming finalizer errors)
Create Python/TS/Go examples that show v1 -> v2 transformations with before/after code snippets and short notes about CPU/memory impact
Implement codemod prototype (typescript-based AST tool) that replaces deprecated call signatures and flags potential manual review points
Add GH Action in sdk-* repos to generate draft changelog snippets from commit annotations and include deprecation notes into the release checklist
Run migration on a subset of sample repos and collect telemetry about breakages (tag telemetry: 'sdk_migration_v2')
PRs: docs PR, codemod PR, GH Action PR, example repos PRs; link all PRs in the ticket
comments: 2026-02-21 Marco Liu: Initial spike completed. Confirmed streaming semantics change: v2 yields 'chunk-level' metadata on every event (cursor, delta_tokens, cumulative_cost). This requires small client API shape changes to carry metadata without disrupting incremental decode flows.

2026-02-25 Aisha Rahman: Decided to call the higher-level streaming model 'StreamFlow' in docs to reduce confusion with generic streams. Will propose API patterns: .on('delta', handler) + .on('meta', handler) for JS; async iterator that yields (chunk, meta) tuples for Python; channel type in Go.

2026-03-01 Engineering review (Seth Park): Suggested avoiding nested callback explosion in TS; recommend a single on('event', {type, payload}) pattern to ease migration. Seth also requested that codemod highlight places where customers implemented custom retries at application layer.

2026-03-04 PM review (Laura Gutierrez): Asked for explicit guidance for Dedicated and Private customers re: determinism—note that retries may be disabled by policy in some infra configs and document how to detect that via response headers.

2026-03-07 Design (Nina Patel): Added UX suggestions for Console: surfacing 'migration risk' banners on SDK routes and offer a one-click toggle to test v2 client in sandbox mode. We'll track separately (DES-...)

2026-03-10 Aisha Rahman: Codemod prototype ready. It flags 3 common patterns: (1) positional retry args, (2) stream callback signatures expecting raw strings, (3) implicit closure over request-scoped metadata. Running against 12 internal repos found 9 instances needing manual review. PR: github.com/redwood/sdk-codemods/pull/42

2026-03-11 Marco Liu: GH Action for changelog generation implemented as draft. It scans commits for token [sdk:breaking] [sdk:deprecate] [sdk:note] and emits CHANGELOG fragment to .github/changelog-drafts/<release>.md. PR: github.com/redwood/sdk-actions/pull/11

2026-03-12 Aisha Rahman: Working on doc examples for Go. Need runtime signoff on default backoff values (runtime/ops requested slightly larger base when CUDA kernels are warm). Scheduling sync with runtime team tomorrow.
migration_examples:
Python before: client.stream_generate(prompt, on_delta=lambda s: print(s))
Python after: async for chunk, meta in client.stream_generate_v2(prompt):
  print(chunk)
  if meta['cursor'] is not None: save_cursor(meta['cursor'])

TypeScript before: client.on('delta', (s) => appendToDom(s))
TypeScript after: client.stream('generate', opts).on('event', (e) => { if (e.type === 'delta') appendToDom(e.payload); if (e.type === 'meta') updateCursor(e.payload.cursor); })
deprecations_summary: Deprecated: positional retry parameters on all language SDKs; replace with retry: {policy: 'exponential', base_ms, factor, jitter, max_retries}
Deprecated: stream callbacks that assume single-string payloads; migrate to event-based or tuple yields to access metadata
Deprecated: implicit client-global idempotency token behavior; v2 requires explicit idempotency_key for any retryable mutating call
automation_notes: Changelog automation rules: commits must include one of [sdk:breaking|sdk:deprecate|sdk:note]; action will attach draft to release PR and post a migration checklist comment
Action will run codemod in --dry-run on example repos and attach a report artifact to the release PR
Telemetry: add 'sdk_migration_v2' tag to internal telemetry events when codemod applied or migration examples executed
